blurb: Wauhatchie Woodlands offers 27 tiny cabins and three custom homes nestled at the base of Lookout Mountain over the Tennessee River. Guests enjoy easy access to natural beauty and downtown Chattanooga attractions. Amenities include private hot tubs, fire pits, a general store, pickleball court, petting zoo, and playground.
